claim: Ours, our reading of the owner's ruling write-state-for-an-agent-reader: state an agent needs lives in the repository, generated by a tool and tested for staleness, as data a command can filter rather than prose read whole; each open item says where it is owned and how to check it, and what is not known is said so. Private agent notes are not read by the next agent.
evidence: Done this way in llmapper: projects/blood-city/reports/STATUS.md is written by the build and filtered with projects/blood-city/level/status.py; docs/module-map.md is generated and its staleness tested (tools/module_map.py); this shelf is checked by tools.findings check. 2026-11-19 onward.
use: Put anything a later agent needs in a generated, queryable file, not in private notes.
